title: These do the job needed.  Keeping things in place.
text: These do the job needed.  Keeping things in place.. I love these.  They are great for holding my socks and underwear in the camper.  No shuffling together of the small items.  They are also great for kitchen utensils.  They will not fit long items like spatulas and such but they do hold items, like peelers, scissors and other shorter items.
